correctness.rationale: Exact Pauli support constraints split after two losses. For all masks outside four-run and close-five patterns, each cluster has stabilizer rank \(\le1\) and is fully separable. Four consecutive survivors yield an explicit one-site partial-transpose eigenvalue \(-1/8\). A union bound gives \(\Pr(H_n)\le16nr^5\), and rigorous factorial-moment Poisson convergence plus disjoint blocks give the asymptotic regimes. Standalone exact checker passed 64,512 masks in dimensions 10–15; finite tests are corroboration, not the limit proof.
